items.title: Australians paying 'unjustified' fees to pharmacies, report says
items.description: Taxpayers are missing out on cheaper medicines due to backroom deals by one of Australia's most powerful lobby groups, according to a new report.

items.title: Iran hits Arab states after third round of US strikes this week
items.description: The US says its forces are "prepared and positioned" to ensure freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, after Iran declared it closed following another round of American strikes.

items.title: Government to crack down on antisemitism on university campuses
items.description: The new standards will require institutions to adopt definitions of antisemitism, racism against Aboriginal and Torres Straight Islander peoples, and Islamophobia.

items.title: Lindsey Graham, pivotal US Republican senator, dies suddenly at 71
items.description: US senator Lindsey Graham, a key Republican who went from a vocal critic of Donald Trump to one of his most loyal allies, has died at age 71.

items.title: Body of missing Queensland mum found in bushland
items.description: A 48-year-old man has been charged with murder after the body of missing mother Jana Armstrong was found in bushland late on Saturday.

items.title: 'Beat the bastard': Arrow vows to help others fight MND
items.description: Former NRL player Jai Arrow says he is determined to raise money and awareness for Motor Neurone Disease until a cure is found.

items.title: Family of Perth man raises questions over his Bali death
items.description: The family of Perth man Cameron Hughes, who died in a Bali immigration detention centre, says it has many questions about the circumstances surrounding his death.

items.title: Why Norway feels 'bitter' after contest of controversy against England
items.description: Norway felt England's equaliser shouldn't have stood after the ball appeared to get a deflection off a wire holding up the "spidercam" above the pitch, directly leading to England gaining possession and scoring.

items.title: Young woman stopped taking the pill because of mental health concerns
items.description: Two young women say taking the pill to manage painful periods had side effects they weren't expecting.

items.title: Souths win on Arrow's birthday, Cowboys and Storm snatch late victories
items.description: South Sydney captain Cam Murray praised his side for being able to focus on the field as the league celebrated the "world's biggest birthday party" for Jai Arrow.

items.title: Lions thump the Bombers to grab top-four spot
items.description: Brisbane Lions have taken a big win over Essendon to snatch a top-four spot after round 18, as Melbourne and the Western Bulldogs enjoy their respective victories. Follow live.

items.title: Bellingham goes big time again, as England continues down hard road
items.description: Jude Bellingham has been scrutinised and criticised in the months leading up to the World Cup. Now he stands as England's best player so far, carrying the Three Lions' title dreams on his shoulders.

items.title: Man wanted over alleged attempted murder of 74yo Sydney man
items.description: An arrest warrant has been issued for a 45-year-old man in connection to a violent assault in Western Sydney on Saturday.

items.title: Owner taken to court over $1m damage bill to iconic 110yo cafe
items.description: The heritage-listed former Paragon Cafe in Katoomba was once considered a success story of Greek entrepreneurship, but has now landed in the NSW Land and Environment Court.

items.title: Love story: Moana Hope has re-learnt what love means
items.description: The former AFLW player was an adult when she realised her childhood had warped her understanding of love.

items.title: How WWI helped shape what you call this deli meat
items.description: The words we use for a handful of classic Australian foods can tell a lot about where we come from.

items.title: From Heath Ledger protégé to abuse survivor, Grace Woodroofe perseveres
items.description: Heath Ledger launched her music career at just 17, but an emotionally abusive relationship with a fellow musician derailed it. A decade on, Grace Woodroofe is releasing the soundtrack to her survival.

items.title: Frozen thermometers and drunk scientists: Inside Shackleton's Antarctic expedition
items.description: Hidden for more than a century, a remarkable collection is offering a rare glimpse into the famed 1900s Discovery expedition to Antarctica.

items.title: UK police arrest 28-year-old man in Ann Widdecombe murder case
items.description: Police previously arrested, then later released, a 26-year-old man in relation to the alleged murder, after Ann Widdecombe's body was found in her residence on Thursday.

items.title: 'Fierce attack': Victim refuses to clean antisemitic graffiti off property
items.description: The victim of an antisemitic attack says he doesn't want to clean up offensive graffiti sprayed on his Adelaide property, because he wants the public to see his family was targeted

items.title: Junior doctor faces court over death of man in Fremantle
items.description: A junior doctor from Perth's western suburbs appears in court charged with manslaughter following the death of a 63-year-old man near Fremantle's entertainment strip in the early hours yesterday.

items.title: In this friendship group there are 'no Jews, no Muslims, just one big family'
items.description: When a group of Jewish mates decided to support a newly arrived Muslim family, all of their lives would change. Together they have flipped expectations about religion and friendship.

items.title: Theoretical 'mirror life' could grow out of control, scientists fear
items.description: This year, scientists included a new potential threat in their decision to move the Doomsday Clock closer to midnight. So what is 'mirror life' and why are they concerned?

items.title: Man charged after filming inside Dezi Freeman's hideout
items.description: A man who entered the property where Dezi Freeman had been hiding out in north-east Victoria has been charged with trespass.

items.title: Time to bite the bullet? Unpopular decision looms over $600m Aboriginal gallery
items.description: Adelaide's stalled Aboriginal cultural centre has a dubious future on a site with a troubled past. The Malinauskas government faces criticism whatever it chooses to do, writes state political reporter Thomas Kelsall.
